title: Prospective Cohort Study of Patients Intolerant to High Pressure Under Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Treated With Bilevel Positive Airway Pressure as Second-line Therapy.
brief_summary: Prospective observational study of obstructive Sleep Apnea patients treated with Bilevel Positive Airway Pressure: AirCurve 10 VAutoTM
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patient
* Obstructive Sleep Apnea Patient previously treated by Continuous positive airway pressure non-compliant to therapy
* Patient naive of bilevel Positive Airway Pressure therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Bilevel positive airway pressure Contraindication
* Severe respiratory disease diagnostic
study_population: Obstructive sleep apnea patient, non compliant or intolerant to Continous positive Airway Pressure therapy, treated by Bilevel Positive Airway Pressure (Aircurve 10 VAutoTM ) as second line therapy.
